# BriefSnap — LLM.txt

> Paid document summarization on Base mainnet via x402.
> $1.00 per summarization request.

## Endpoints

### Summarize ($1.00)
POST /api/summarize
Body: { "text": "...", "length?"?: "short" }

## Protocol
All requests use x402 payment on Base mainnet (eip155:8453).
PayTo: 0x7861db4efc14a1ed5dd8c96c528a3796560f1393
Facilitator: https://x402-agent-pay.com/facilitator

## Health
GET /health — returns 200 when service is ready

## Example
curl -X POST https://briefsnap-x402.fly.dev/api/summarize \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"text": "The quarterly earnings showed strong growth across all segments."}'
